description: Explains New York's LLC publication requirement: LLC Law §206 for New York LLCs, §802 for out-of-state (foreign) LLCs registered in New York, and §1203 for PLLCs. Covers the two newspapers, six weeks, the 120-day deadline, the Certificate of Publication and what happens if it is missed.

llc_type.description: llc = formed in New York (default); foreign_llc = formed in another state and registered in New York; pllc = professional LLC.

name: get_publication_requirements
title: New York LLC publication requirements
